segments.text: Day 24 · Indexing: B-tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN, partial, covering।
What: The index types Postgres offers beyond the default B-tree, each suited to a different data shape (full-text, geometric, append-only, filtered).
How to complete: Rehearsed strength — for a given query, practice picking the right index type (e.g.
GIN for JSONB, BRIN for time-ordered logs) and justifying it aloud.
